segments.expected: "I wrote that down. I write everything down." The Reader shut the satchel. "Tomorrow they'll read it aloud in a dock. All of it. Yours and hers and the keepers'." She looked at Kiva for a long moment. "I've kept that page in the dark for nine months so that it could be believed. I'd like you to know I've never once been curious what's on it. I'll be curious tomorrow."
